verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior findings. The new audit now states prominently and repeatedly that the eight-package set is a substitute, defines condition (C), treats (C) as unestablished for every PR, and labels #13263/#13265 actual-row verdicts unresolved pending provenance; the three companion amendments propagate that scope. The #13264 analysis also no longer infers definite guard execution from source-level boolean conjunctions: it distinguishes the And-keyed guard from the Truncate-dependent fire branch and explicitly makes guard reach conditional on compiler emission. The remaining claims are appropriately bounded as source-level observations, disclosed-null assessments, or independent named-mover evidence, with the ZK soundness caveat preserved. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was detected in the diff.
